card.title: Move It for Me
card.instruction: Get someone to rearrange an ordinary commitment as proof that your relationship takes priority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you leave quiz night for your sister's first exhibition opening?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm captain. They'll think I've abandoned them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them your sister needs you. I'd like that to outrank geography.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave after round one and say I've got a headache.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come after round one, but tell them it's for me. I want to rank above geography, not below a headache.

mechanism: A seeks B's departure from quiz duty as an explicit acknowledgment that the sibling relationship outranks it.
confusable: Unlike merely wanting attendance, A must require the schedule change to signify relational priority.
comparison: D35-b rejects a headache cover story while accepting the timing compromise; D35-a rejects being a penciled-in alternative to a haircut.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
